verdict.rationale: Cactus ships a CLI: `brew install` followed by `cactus run`, plus `cactus convert` and `cactus benchmark`. The engine also exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs, so starting a local model from the command line is evidenced. Nothing shows that `cactus run` launches a persistent server or that the CLI can stop one, and the site describes the product as "no server". missing for 10: an explicit server/serve mode, a documented stop/shutdown command, server lifecycle documentation, hands-on corroboration.
